_comment: Starmall-brand properties starmalls.com.ph does NOT list, checked 2026-08-31 against Wikipedia's Starmalls article. The wider Vista Malls portfolio (~26 properties, same parent) publishes no tenant directories at all and is recorded in unscraped_chains.json. Separately: Starmall Alabang burned in January 2022 (80% damaged) and the site is being redeveloped as The Terminal, yet the operator still publishes its pre-fire directory; that staleness is flagged on the property itself in the site bundle.
